title: NASA Made Matter Colder Than Nature
hook: NASA reached 0.0000000001 kelvin—colder than deep space.
closing: Human-made cold opens experiments the nearby universe cannot provide.
question: What could ultracold atoms reveal?

segments.say: Deep space sits at 2.7 kelvin; even emptiness cannot match the Boomerang Nebula.
NASA's Cold Atom Lab reached 0.0000000001 kelvin, pushing matter beyond nature's coldest known setting.
The lab is only 250 miles overhead, turning unreachable natural cold into a nearby experiment.
